summary: All 9 production-readiness bug fixes verified and full regression from iteration 1 passes. Frontend supervisor was restarted once because the dev server was serving a cached (stale) version of public/index.html; after restart, the new head content (theme-color x2, manifest link, apple-mobile-web-app meta) is served correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend dev server (CRA) caches public/index.html in memory — future edits to index.html require a supervisorctl restart frontend to reflect on the preview URL (already done in this run). Consider documenting this or automating via a nodemon-style watcher.

Two vercel.json files (root and frontend/) are 100% duplicated — DRY violation. Recommend keeping only /app/vercel.json for a monorepo deployment or /app/frontend/vercel.json if deploying from frontend subdir, but not both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview served HTML matches /app/frontend/public/index.html only AFTER `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. If HTML changes seem missing, restart the dev server first. Lead-form testids are form-name/form-phone/form-location/form-vehicle/form-problem/form-submit (not lead-*). City link testids are city-{slug} (not city-link-{slug}).
